title: Editor's pick: Dispatch Biotherapeutics - Nature Biotechnology
gist: Nature Biotechnology's annual editor's pick spotlights Dispatch Bio, a well-funded early-stage company that delivers antigens to solid tumors to make them targetable by CAR T cell immunotherapy.

themes.theme: Solid-tumor CAR T targeting via antigen delivery

insights.claim: Dispatch Bio delivers antigens to solid tumors so they can be targeted by CAR T immunotherapy, tackling the core problem that solid tumors lack the clean surface antigens that made CAR T successful in blood cancers.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: A platform that paints solid tumors with a universal antigen could unlock the far larger solid-tumor market for cell therapy.
insights.quote: Dispatch Bio delivers antigens to solid tumors for CAR T immunotherapy.

insights.claim: Nature Biotechnology each year highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year, and it named Dispatch Bio among its picks.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Inclusion flags Dispatch Bio as a venture-backed company to watch in the solid-tumor cell-therapy race.
insights.quote: Each year, Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year.
